hooks.name: Block Database Migrations
hooks.description: Mencegah saya menjalankan perintah migrasi database apapun (migrate, seed, rollback, fresh)

action.command:
powershell -Command "
\$input = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json
\$command = \$input.tool.arguments.command -join ' '

# Check if command contains migration keywords
if (\$command -match '(migrate|seed|rollback|fresh)' -and \$command -match 'artisan') {
    Write-Error 'Database migrations are blocked. This task cannot perform database operations.'
    exit 2
}

exit 0
"
